tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// gzhi gsum gyi cho ga phan bde'i gnyen zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// 'khor ba'i tshad gdung ma lus zhi mdzad la// dus kyis yol ba mi 'gyur chos kyi sprin// bgrang yas skye dgu'i dge legs char gyi khungs// spro mkhas thub dbang gangs ri'i gnas la 'dud// 'dir gso sbyong gi gzhi la/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin 'du bar 'os pa 'dus/ sher snying 'don/ de nas dge slong gcig gis spyod lam bsgreng*/ mkhan po'am/ slob dpon nam/ gnas brtan nam/ tshe dang ldan pa che ge mos gtso bo mdzad pa'i dge 'dun btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ deng dgun zla dang po'i zla ba mar gyi ngo'i gral tshes bco lnga pa mngon du gyur pa lags te/ gtsug lag khang gi bdag po dang*/ gtsug lag khang gi lha rnams kyi slad du/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i mdo re bklag tu gsol/ de nas dge 'dun rnams kyis dang por phyag bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul bya'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs kyi rdul dri ma med pa la mgo bos rab tu gtugs te gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe// sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bor nas// nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs// de tshe mkhas pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba// mgon po mchog brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum na mdzes// mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mi mchog 'dul ba kha lo sgyur mdzad cing*// kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs// dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas// mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i gzhi// de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// rgyas par spro na bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa yang bya'o// bar du mdo 'don pa ni/

gsol ba btab pa'i dge slong des kyang spro zhing nus na theg pa che chung gi bka' dri ma med pa rgyas pa 'don par bya zhing*/ gcig gis mi nus na mang po res kyis kyang bshad par bya'o// de tsam mi nus na mdor bsdus pa 'di tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ rang gis/ gang zhig gser mchog rang bzhin ri rab la gnas man+dā ra dang lhar bcas gnod sbyin dang*// gdengs ka nor bu'i 'od kyis mun pa sel mdzad sa 'og gnas pa'i klu rnams gang yin dang*// gangs can rir ni dpal gyis rol zhing rab tu dga' ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa gang yin pa// de dag thams cad thar pa dam pa'i sgor gyur thub pa'i gsung mnyan phyir ni 'dir gshegs shig /lha dang lha min mi'am ci yi dbang po dang*// brgya byin la sogs chos kyi phyogs la bya ba byas pa rnams// sangs rgyas gsung rab rab tu zhi zhing bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// 'di dag bshad kyis dam pa'i chos nyan phyir ni 'dir gshegs shig /gang dag phyogs bcu stong gi 'jig rten na// bde gshegs slob mar gyur pa gang su dag /deng 'dir ston pa chos kyi char 'bebs kyis// nyan par 'dod pa thams cad 'dir gshegs shig /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag shes pa ni 'grib/ srog ni 'chad/ tshe'i 'du byed ni 'dor/ ston pa'i bstan pa yang nges par 'jig par 'gyur bas/ ci'i phyir brtson 'grus dang rtul ba brtan pos sgrub par mi byed/ mi'i lus ni shin tu rnyed par dka' na/ de thob nas des rnyed pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba yang rnyed nas thar pa'i don dang mi mthun pa dag gis bslus te sdug bsngal bar gyur ta re/

dge slong dag srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni bla'i/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni de lta ma yin no// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srog dang bral zhing 'chi bas ni tshe 'di nyid kyi skye ba zad par 'gyur gyi/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni skye ba 'bum phrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde ba spangs te rnam par ltung ba chen po nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro// de phyir ston pas tshul khrims rab bsngags bshad// tshul khrims ldan pa sangs rgyas 'byung dang phrad// tshul khrims ldan pa rgyan rnams kun gyi mchog /tshul khrims ldan pa dri dang byug pa yin// tshul khrims ldan pa dga' ba kun gyi gnas// tshul khrims ldan pa gdung ba bsil ba'i chu// tshul khrims ldan pa 'jig rten kun gyis bstod// tshul khrims dag pas 'gro ba dam pa mnos// ji ltar sbrul gdug klu chen nag po yang*// tshul khrims ldan la gnod med gzhan ci smos// tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong 'od dang ldan// tshul khrims ldan pa grags 'gyur bde ba 'thob// ji ltar mig med gzugs mthong mi rung ltar// de bzhin tshul khrims med na chos mi mthong*// ji ltar rkang med lam 'jug ga la nus// de bzhin tshul khrims med na thar mi 'gyur// ji ltar bum pa bzang po rin chen snod// de bzhin tshul khrims chos rnams bskyed pa'i gzhi// ji ltar bum chag rin chen snod mi rung*// de bzhin tshul khrims ral bas chos kun gtugs// dang po tshul khrims med par gyur pa de// phyis nas mya ngan 'das pa 'thob snyam mam// sna med sna rdum la sogs gang yin pa// de la me long dag ni dgos mi 'gyur// rna bas ma thos mig sngar ma mthong yang*// bstan bsrungs mi de mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur// thos mang thos ldan thos bsrung mtho ris nyid// bud med bsten du ga la rung*// rgyal po'i pho brang ga la dga'// longs spyod rtag pa ga la yod// bud med dag la rung ba med// rgyal srid dag la dga' ba med// lbu ba dag la snying po med// longs spyod dag la snying po med// longs spyod dag ni 'bab chu bzhin// gru de ci 'dra khyim de 'dra// me tog ci 'dra gzugs de bzhin// srog ni chu bur 'dra ba yin// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/

nye bar 'khor la sogs pa'i dge slong de dag yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/// / mtha' mar bsod nams bsngo ba ni// bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// ces dang*/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu// zhes sogs dang*/ klu rgyal dga' bo nyer dga' bo// gzhan yang gror khyer gnas pa rnams// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs// rtag tu bde ba thob par shog /ces brjod do// de dag dus rgyun gyi dge 'dun gyi bya ba yin pas rgyun chags gsum pa'o// de nas dge tshul rnams kyi mdo 'don pa rang la dmigs te dgongs gsol byas nas/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ byis pa nyid dang*/ mi shes pa nyid dang*/ bag ma mchis pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa mang ba'i dbang gis bshags bya'i nyes byas gang byung ba de thams cad/ mkhan po la sogs pa brjod nas/ drung du mthol lo// 'chags so// mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol zhing ma bshags na mi 'gyur ro// zhes lan gsum bzlas/ mdo 'don pas de dag la/ nyes pa la nyes par gzigs lags sam/ zhes dri/ de dag gis/ mthong lags so// phyis nas legs par sdom lags sam/ zhes dri/ sdom lags so// lan gsum/ nyes pa gang byung ba ngos zin na de nyid kyi ming smos nas bshags pa byas pas chog go /gzhug tu mdo 'don pas/ thabs yin no// dge tshul rnams kyis/ legs so// zhes brjod/ de ni dge tshul rnams kyi bshags pa'o// dge tshul rnam par dag pa zhig na 'di mi dgos so// de nas sngar bzhin dgongs gsol byas// deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am/ bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes bdag mchi na/

bdag bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag par mkhan po sogs kyis gzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum bzlas la thabs legs bya'o// de ni dge tshul gyi yongs dag ste de dag gi gso sbyong ngo*// de nas dge tshul rnams gyes la/ dge slong ltung ba dang bcas pa rnams bshags par 'os pa bshags/ bsdam par 'os pa bsdams/ de'i nyin rang la 'chos mi thub pa lhag ma lta bu la byin gyis brlab dgos pas/ dang po ni/ gzhan dge tshul bzhin la/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bya bas zhes smos pas so// gnyis pa ni/ yid kyis bsdam par 'os pa rnams yid kyis bsdam pa'o// gsum pa la/ der 'dus pa'i dge slong las gcig rnam par dag la/ gzhan lhag ma'am spang ba'i ltung ba las gang yang rung ba zhig dang bcas pa yin na/ de dag so sos dge slong dag pa'i mdun du dgongs gsol byas la/ bdag shākya'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba byis pa nas/ mang ba'i dbang gis dge 'dun lhag ma'i sde tshan las khu ba phyung ba'i lhag ma'am/ spang ba ltung byed kyi sde tshan las// gos zhag bcu 'chang ba'i spang ltung 'di byung ste/ ltung ba de tshe dang ldan pa'i mdun du byin gyis brlab bo// deng ltung ba de byin gyis brlabs te dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong mdzad la/ slad kyi ltung ba de chos bzhin du slar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum bzlas la thabs legs bya/ gal te dge slong thams cad de rnams gang rung gi ltung ba dang bcas par gyur la bshags yul ma rnyed na thun mong ba byin gyis brlab pa 'di bya ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong lags la/ bdag cag dge 'dun thams cad ni ltung ba dang bcas par gyur na/ gang gi mdun du bdag cag ltung ba de slar chos bzhin du bgyi ba/ bdag cag las dge slong gnas gzhan du mchis la/ dge slong gi mdun du ltung ba chos bzhin du slar bgyi bar spro ba su yang ma mchis na/

gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis deng ltung ba byin gyis brlabs te gso sbyong mdzad la slad kyi dge slong gi mdun du ltung ba de dag chos bzhin du slar mdzad do// 'di ni gsol ba'o// 'di la thams cad la ltung ba byung ma byung som nyi dang bcas pa/ rtsod pa dang bcas pa/ nges pa nyid ma yin pa so so la byin brlab gsungs kyang bod rnams mthun pa kho na phyag len mdzad gda'o// de nas gnas la blo mthun bya ste/ las byed pas thog mar gsol ba'i las la thugs gtad par zhu zhes brjod la/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bzhed na/ gal te dge 'dun rnams kyis dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang ba mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad grub pa'am/ bgyis pa'am/ lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi'o// 'di ni gsol ba'o// brjod pa mjug sdud dang bcas pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ gnas thams cad grub pa'am bgyis pa lags pa nang mtshams dang phyi rol nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su bzhed de/ de'i slad du dge 'dun gyis gnas thams cad nas 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di/ dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag gnas thams cad nas 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyi bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung zhig gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas dge 'dun gyi gnas thams cad nas 'dom gang dang bcas pa 'di/

dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong gi gnas su blo mthun par bgyis lags te/ 'di ltar/ cang mi gsung bas/ de de bzhin du 'dzin to// zhes brjod pas so// de nas las byed pas so so thar pa'i mdo la ston pa'i 'du shes/ rang nyid bslab pa la gces spras su byed pa'i 'du shes/ chos kyi tshul 'di la brten nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa'i 'du shes te/ de ltar thugs la bzhag nas thams cad kyis gsan par zhu zhes brjod la/ thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum na grags// dam pa'i chos sgra seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa// thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog mdzod brnyes pa// zhabs la tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bus gtugs// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho gting mtha' med brgal ba// 'gro ba'i gtso la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bslab gzhi dkon mchog snod// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su dbye bar bya// sangs rgyas 'dul ba gangs chen mtsho// gting mtha' med pa thams cad kyi// gnas pa'i snying dang snying po ni// so so thar pa 'di yin no// 'di ni dam chos rgyal po yi// chos kun gyi ni 'dren pa'i mchog /'di ni dge slong tshong tshogs kyi// bslab zong tshong khang chen po yin// tshul khrims 'chal pas zin rnams kyi// gdung ba sel ba'i sman 'di yin// 'di ni lang tsho'i rnam 'phrul ba'i// rkang gnyis gzhon nu'i lcags kyu yin// mtsho bas zab pa'i 'khor ba las// sgrol ba'i brgal thabs 'di yin te// 'di ni bzang 'gror 'gro ba yi// nges pa'i chu lon zam pa yin// 'di ni nyon mongs pham byed lam// rgyal po yi ni 'dren pa mchog /'di ni thar pa'i grong 'jug pa'i// them skas bzhi dang 'dra bar gnas// nga ni mya ngan 'das gyur na// 'di ni khyed kyi ston pa zhes// rang byung nyid kyis gus bcas par// nan tan dge slong tshogs mdun bstod// sangs rgyas zhes bya'i sgra 'di yang*// 'jig rten dag na rab tu dkon// mi nyid rnyed pa shin tu dka'// rab tu byung ba shin tu dkon// de bzhin rab tu byung rnams kyi// tshul khrims phun sum tshogs rab dkon// tshul khrims yongs su dag gyur kyang*// grogs bzang shin tu rnyed par dka'// 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang*// mi dang rab tu 'byung ba dang*/

tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa dang*// grogs bzang rnyed dka' rnyed gyur nas// mkhas pa bdag la legs 'dod cing*// de dag 'bras bcas byed 'dod pas// sdom brtson rnams kyis so so thar// mnyan pa'i phyir ni 'bad par bya// dge slong dbang dul kun dbang po// sangs rgyas mi 'gyur rab byung ba// nges par thar par 'dod rnams kyis// so so thar pa rtag tu srungs// bskal pa bye ba rnams su yang*// so so thar pa thos pa dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnyed dka' ste// bsgrub la'ang shin tu rnyed par dka'// sangs rgyas rnams ni 'byung ba bde// chos bstan pa yang bde ba yin// dge 'dun mthun pa bde ba ste// mthun pa rnams kyi dka' thub bde// 'phags pa rnams ni mthong ba bde// dam pa dag dang 'grogs pa bde// byis pa rnams ni ma mthong na// rtag tu bde ba nyid du 'gyur// tshul khrims ldan pa mthong ba bde// mang du thos pa mthong ba bde// yang srid rnam par grol ba yi// dgra bcom pa dag mthong ba bde// 'jug ngogs snyoms pa'i chu klung bde// chos la goms pa'i skye bo bde// shes rab thob par gyur pa bde// nga 'o nga rgyal zad pa bde// nges par byas shing dbang po dul ba dag /dgon pa zhi ba rnams su rgas gyur kyang*// mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag tu// lang tsho yol ba rnams kyi gnas pa bde// de yan so thar mdo'i bstod pa'o// tshe dang ldan pa dag dgun rnams kyi zla ba dang po'i phyed ni thal lo// lhag ma phyed ni shul na lus so// tshe dang ldan pa dag rga ba dang 'chi ba mngon par 'ong zhing ston pa'i bstan pa yang 'jig par 'gyur bas/ tshe dang ldan pa dag gis bag yod pas rnal 'byor du bya'o// de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dang*/ gzhan yang gang dag de lta bu dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs rnams kyang bag yod pas thob bo// bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni don nyung ba bya ba nyung ba yin la/

dge 'dun gyi thog mar bya ba ci yod/ tshe dang ldan pa dag ma lhags pa rnams la 'dun pa dang yongs su dag pa dris shig dris nas kyang brjod par bya'o// zhes gnas brtan gyis brjod ma thag tu dge skos kyis tshul shing brim pas dge slong rnams bgrang bar bya zhing*/ mtshams bcad pa'am las kyi mtshams ma bcad kyang grwa tshang lta bu rang bzhin gyis mtshams bcad par song bas de'i 'du 'os ma tshang na 'di man dgag dgos byung na ma gtogs mi byed/ ma lhags pa rnams la 'dun pa dang yongs dag rim can nam cig car len pa las phyi ma len pa po'i mdun du/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bco lnga pa'am bcu bzhi pa lags la/ bdag dge slong bro 'tshal ba/ sdug bsngal ba/ bro tshabs che ba/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang gso sbyong bco lnga pa'am bcu bzhi pa lags te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes bdag mchi'o// dge 'dun chos bzhin du mdzad pa la 'dun pa dbul lo// bdag gi gso sbyong yang yongs su dag go /'dun pa yongs su dag pa yang brjod do// brjod pa yang rig par bgyid do// zhes lan gsum brjod de/ de nas len pa pos dge 'dun la brjod pa ni/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bco lnga pa'am bcu bzhi pa lags la/ gnas che ge mo zhig na dge slong bro 'tshal ba/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang gso sbyong bco lnga pa'am bcu bzhi pa lags la/ dge slong bro 'tshal ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes kho na nyid mchi'o// dge 'dun chos bzhin mdzad pa la 'dun pa 'bul lo// de'i gso sbyong yang yongs su dag go /'dun pa dang yongs su dag pa yang brjod do// brjod pa yang rig par bgyi'o// zhes lan gcig brjod do// 'di man dgos/ de nas gnas brtan gyi 'di skad ces/

shākya seṅge de la ni// sor mo bcu yis thal sbyar te// so so thar pa 'don par bya// gdul ba'i don du nga las nyon// thos na drang srong chen po yis// ji skad gsung bzhin bsgrub bya zhing*// kha na ma tho phra rnams la// rtun cing byed pa nyid du gyis// rtag tu 'bad pas 'da' ba yis// sems rta kha blan dka' ba la// mthun pa gzer gnon rgyab pa yi// srab ni so so thar 'di yin// che ba gang dag ngag tsam gyis// ldog cing mtshams las mi 'da' ba// de dag mi rta bzang po ste// nyon mongs g.yul las nges rgyal 'gyur// su la srab 'di med pa dang*// nam du'ang 'dod par mi 'gyur bar// de dag nyon mongs g.yul gyis dkrugs// 'jog bral rnam par 'khyams par 'gyur// de dag dang por bya ba'o// dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa'am bco lnga pa lags te/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ deng dge 'dun gso sbyong mdzad de/ so so thar pa'i mdo gdon par gdon to// 'di ni gsol ba'o// tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag cag gso sbyong bya ste/ so so thar pa'i mdo gdon par gdon gyis/ khyed cag su la ltung ba yod pa des mthol zhig ltung ba med na cang ma smra zhig cang mi smra na bdag gis tshe dang ldan pa dag yongs su dag par rig par bya'o// ji ltar so sor dris nas/ dge slong gis lan btab pa de bzhin du/ dge slong gis 'khor 'di lta bur yang lan gsum gyi bar du bsgrag par bya ba yin no// gleng gzhi rnam par bzhag pa 'dzin du 'jug pa'o// yang dge slong gang*/ dge slong gi 'khor 'di lta bur lan gsum gyis bsgrags pa na/ ltung ba yod pa dran bzhin mthong bzhin du mi mthol na/ de shes bzhin du brdzun du smra ba yin no// tshe dang ldan pa dag shes bzhin du brdzun du smra ba ni/

bcom ldan 'das kyis bar du gcod pa'i chos su gsungs so// de bas na dge slong ltung ba byung ba rnam par dag par 'dod pas/ ltung ba yod la dran bzhin mthong ba mthol bar bya'o// mthol na de bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro// tshe dang ldan pa dag bdag gis so so thar pa'i mdo gdon pa'i gleng gzhi bton zin to// de la bdag gis/ tshe dang ldan pa dag la ci 'di la khyed yongs su dag gam zhes dri'o// ci 'di la khyed yongs su dag gam zhes lan gnyis lan gsum du dri'o// 'di la tshe dang ldan pa dag yongs su dag na 'di ltar cang mi smra bas de bzhin du 'dzin to// lhag ma rnams ni thos pa bsgrags pas kyang rung bas/ 'di skad ces/ tshe dang ldan pa dag slad ma pham par 'gyur pa'i chos bzhi dang*/ dge 'dun lhag ma'i chos bcu gsum dang*/ ma nges pa gnyis dang*/ spang ba ltung byed sum cu dang*/ 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu dang*/ so sor bshags par bya ba bzhi dang*/ bslab par bya ba'i chos mang po dang*/ rtsod pa zhi bar bya ba'i chos bdun po rnams ni zla ba phyed phyed cing so so thar pa'i mdo gdon pa las 'byung bas sngar gsan pa'am phyis kyang gsan par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod par bya'o// pham pa 'don na so thar bzhin bton nas lhag ma man chad thos bsgrags/ des gzhan gnyis la rigs 'gre'o// brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya// sangs rgyas bstan la 'jug par bya// 'dam bu'i tshal la glang chen bzhin// 'chi bdag sde ni gzhom par bya// gang zhig rab tu bag yod pas// chos 'dul 'di la spyod gyur pa// skye ba'i 'khor ba rab spangs nas// sdug bsngal mtha' mar byed par 'gyur// phan tshun tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*// bstan pa 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir// so so thar pa 'di bton pas// dge 'dun gyis ni gso sbyong byas// gang gi phyir ni mdo bton nas// gang phyir gso sbyong byas gyur pas// tshul khrims de ni bsrung bya ste// g.yag rnga'i rtse mo ji bzhin no// thams cad kyis/

so so thar pa bton pa yis// bsod nams grub pa gang yod pa// des ni 'jig rten ma lus pa// thub dbang go 'phang thob par shog /gso sbyong gi nyin bzhir ma tshang na dus kyi bar du bsdad la/ des kyang ma tshang na/ mchod pa bshams la gcig gi mdun du gcig 'dug ste/ 'di skad ces/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go zhes bdag mchi na/ bdag yongs su dag par btsun pas gzung du gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba/ tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ deng gso sbyong byin gyis brlab bo// gang gi tshe dge 'dun tshogs pa rnyed pa de'i tshe dge 'dun dang lhan cig gso sbyong rgya cher nyams su myong bar bya zhing*/ so so thar pa'i mdo gdon pa yang gdon par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ thabs legs bya'o// gcig pus byin gyis rlob pa ni/ lha rnams dgongs su gsol zhes pa dang*/ mthar lha rnams kyis gzung du gsol zhes brje ba ma gtogs snga ma bzhin sbyar bar bya'o/// / gnyis pa dbyar gnas kyi gzhi la/ dbyar sbyor dang*/ dbyar gnas par khas blangs pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ zla ba phyed tsam nas sbyin bdag zhal ta ba spyod yul gyi grong*/ bsod snyoms nad g.yog gnas pa dag la bla ma yod pa dang nyi ma snga ma gnas mal yo byad sta gon bya/ dbyar zla 'bring po de'i nya'i gso sbyong dus gnas mal stob pa/ dge slong gcig gam du ma bsko bar bya ste/ las byed pas dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba khyod dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stob par spro'am zhes dri/ spro zhes zer na las byed pas/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal stob par spro na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na/

dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun kun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stob par bskos te/ gnas mal stob pa ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dge 'dun la dbyar gyi gnas mal bstab bo// 'di ni gsol ba'o// las ni dge 'dun nas gsol/ dge slong nas spro te/ de'i slad du nas bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ gnas mal stob par bsko bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung zhig gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig ces lan gcig go /mjug sdud ni/ dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba gnas mal stob par bskos lags te/ 'di ltar cang mi gsung bas de de bzhin du 'dzin to// zhes brjod do// bskos pa'i dge slong des tshul shing srid du khru gang pa/ ya yo dang khyar khyor dang*/ bcas gcus med pa/ kha dog bzang ba/ dri zhim pa/ reg na 'jam pa rnams sta gon byas la/ gzeb kyi prog mar ras dkar po bting ba bkra shis pa rgan pa'i mthar bzhag la/ rang nyid 'dud pa dang bcas pas 'grengs te/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bkra shis kyi gtsug lag khang che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di na/ khrims su bya ba dbyar dge 'dun gyi nang du 'khrug long gi rgyu bzhi po gang rung gi sgo nas 'khrug long mi bskyed pa 'di dang*/ gnas ral pa dang grum pa bcos pa dang*/ byin gyis ma brlabs par mtshams kyi phyi rol tu skya rengs 'char bar mi bya ba zhes bya ba 'di yod de/ khyed cag las gang khrims su bya ba 'di dang 'dis gnas 'dir gnas par spro ba de tshul shing longs shig khyed cag las sus kyang dbyar dge 'dun gyi nang du 'khrug long bskyed par mi bya'o// khyed cag las gang gis 'ga' zhig las cung zad shes pa des da smros shig khyed cag las gang dbyar gyi nang du dge 'dun la 'khrug long bskyed par gyur pa de la/

dge 'dun gyis phyis nye bar bstan par dgongs so// zhes khrims su bya ba brjod do// de nas tshul shing blangs pa dang dbyar gnas pa khas blang ba'i phyir/ dge 'dun rnams gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las kyis thugs bstun bar bya ste/ las byed pa pos 'di skad ces/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dbyar nye bar bsgrub pa dbyar zla 'bring po'am tha chung gi tshes bco lnga lags na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na/ dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ deng dge 'dun gyis tshul shing bzhes te/ sang nang par dbyar gnas par khas blang ngo*// 'di ni gsol ba'o zhes brjod do// de byas ma thag kho nar tshul shing brims shing*/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi tshul shing dang por blangs/ ston pa'i tshul shing len pa las gzhan pa dge slong gis rang rang gi stan las phyed 'phags pa'i spyod lam gyis rang rang gi tshul shing blang bar bya'o// ston pa man chad nas rgan rim mthar chags su brims nas yang mgo nas/ dge slong gang la slob ma dang*/ nye gnas dge tshul yod pa de la dge tshul rnams kyi tshul shing len du gzhug go /dge tshul rnams kyis tshul shing brims zin pa'i mjug tu gtsug lag khang gi srung ma gnyug mar gnas pa lha mo chen mo 'phrog ma la sogs pa'i tshul shing brims pa de blang bar bya'o// tshul shing sdud pa na thams cad kyis dal bus bzhag par bya zhing*/ bgrangs nas dge 'dun gsan du gsol/ gnas 'dir dge slong de snyed kyis tshul shing blangs so// zhes dge 'dun la bsgo bar bya'o// gnas mal stob pa des sgo lcags dang lde mig blangs nas dang por dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyi mdun du 'dug ste/ gnas brtan/ gtsug lag khang che ge mo ni rnyed pa dang bcas pa/ gos kyi rin dang bcas pa lags kyi/ gal te de bzhed na bzhes shig ces len du gzhug go /de bzhin du rgan rim gyis thams cad la gnas kyi gzhi lhag ma rnams kyang yon tan ji lta ba bzhin du brjod/

mos pa skyed cing len du gzhug go /dge slong gang gis gnas kyi gzhi blangs pa de la de'i sgo lcags dang lde mig gtad/ mal cha yo byad bstab/ stob pa pos/ khyed cag las gang gis kyang dge 'dun gyi gnas mal la gding ba med par longs spyad par mi bya/ gding ba rung ba ma yin pas longs spyad par mi bya/ gding ba dri ma can gyis longs spyad par mi bya'o// zhes bsgo bar bya ba dang*/ dge 'dun sang sbyin bdag che ge mo dang*/ zhal ta ba che ge mo dang*/ spyod yul gyi grong che ge mo dang*/ nad g.yog pa che ge mos gnas par zhal gyis bzhes par 'gyur ro zhes brjod par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ tshes bcu drug gi nyin/ rang rang so so'i gnas steng g.yogs dang bcas par/ dge slong gi mdun du tsog tsog pur 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mtshams kyi nang dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir 'di lta ste/ gnas ral ba dang grum pa bcos pa'i slad du/ sbyin bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dang*/ zhal ta ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dang*/ spyod yul gyi grong khyer che ge mo zhes bgyi ba dang*/ bro g.yog pa che ge mo zhes bgyi bas/ dbyar zla ba gsum gnas par khas blang ngo*// bdag dbyar 'di na mchis shing*/ bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o// dbyar phyi ma khas len na dbyar phyi ma zla ba gsum gnas par khas blang ngo*// zhes sngags kyi bye brag bya'o// dmigs bsal zhag bdun pa'i gnang ba sbyin pa ni mtshams kyi nang du dge slong gcig gi mdun du tsog pur 'dug ste/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ mtshams nang dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas pa las/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba bgyi ba zhig gi slad du/ dgung bdun mtshams kyi slad rol du mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyis slar mchi ba byin gyis brlab bo bdag dbyar 'di na mchis shing*/

bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags so// zhes lan gsum brjod/ thabs legs bya/ yang dge 'dun gyi ched du zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ las byed pas/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod dge 'dun gyi ched du zhag bzhi bcu byin gyis brlabs te/ mtshams kyi phyi rol tu 'gro bar spro'am/ spro'o// de nas dge 'dun la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba gsol ba'i phyir/ phyag gsum byas te/ rgan pa'i mthar tsog pur 'dug ste/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams gsan du gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ nang mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas 'dir dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum gnas par khas blangs te/ bdag dbyar 'di na mchis shing*/ bdag gi dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags pa las/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dge 'dun gyi ched du mtshams kyi slad rol tu mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyi slar mchi bar spro na/ thugs brtse ba can dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyis thugs brtse bas nye bar gzung ste/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsal du gsol zhes lan gsum brjod do// gnang ba ni dge 'dun nas gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ nang mtshams kyi nas khas blangs te/ 'di dbyar 'di na gnas pa las/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ dge 'dun gyi ched du mtshams kyi slad rol tu mchi ba dang*/ de tshun chad kyis slar mchi bar dge 'dun la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba gsol na/ gal te dge 'dun gyis dus la bab cing bzod na dge 'dun gyis gnang bar mdzod cig dang*/ 'di dbyar 'di na mchi zhing gnas pa lags pa las dge 'dun gyi ched du/ mtshams kyi slad rol tu mchi ba dang de tshun chad kyis slar mchi bar dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ dge 'dun gyis zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsol to// 'di ni gsol ba'o// las ni dge 'dun nas gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/

mtshams kyi gnas 'di lags pa las/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ dge 'dun gyi ched lags na/ slar mchi bar dge 'dun la zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsol to// de'i slad du 'di dbyar 'di na mchis shing*/ 'di'i dbyar gyi gnas ni 'di lags pa las/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di dge 'dun gyi ched lags na/ slar mchi bar dge 'dun gyis zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsol na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba stsal bar bzod pa de dag ni cang ma gsung zhig gang dag mi bzod pa de dag gsungs shig mjug sdud dge 'dun gyis bzod cing gnang nas/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dge 'dun gyi ched du zhag bzhi bcu'i gnang ba sbyin lags kyi 'di ltar cang mi gsung bar de ni de de bzhin no zhes 'dzin to// phyir dgag dbye la 'du bar bya'o/// / gsum pa dgag dbye'i gzhi la/ tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin nas tshes bco lnga'i nub mo tshun chos dang ldan pa'i gtam rnam par gtan la dbab pas mtshan mo 'da'/ 'di la yang bshags par 'os pa nas 'dun pa dgag dbye blang ba sogs gso sbyong dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par bdag la mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyi'o// 'dun pa dang dgag dbye yang brjod do// brjod par yang rig par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod cing brjod pa'i tshe yang de skad do// de nas las byed pas 'di skad ces/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod/ dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye byed par spro'am/ spro'o// dge 'dun nas gsol/ dge slong ming 'di zhes bya ba nas spro na gal te nas mdzod cig dang*/ dge 'dun gyis dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ dgag dbye byed par bskos te/ dge slong dgag dbye bgyi ba ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'di/ dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid par 'gyur ro// 'di ni gsol ba'o// las ni dge 'dun nas gsol/

dge slong nas spro ste/ de'i slad du nas bsko na/ tshe dang ldan pa gang dag nas cang ma gsung zhig gang dag mi bzod pa de dag ni gsungs shig ces brjod pa gcig dang mjug sdud pa brjod pa gnas mal stob pa bsko ba dang*/ gzhan 'dra/ de'i 'og tu dge slong las byed pas/ dge 'dun nas gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags te/ gal te nas mdzod cig dang*/ deng dge 'dun dgag dbye mdzad do// 'di ni gsol ba'o// bskos pa des rtswa dar bha dge 'dun thams cad la khyab par 'brim mo// rtswa de yul rten gnyis ka'i lag pas phan tshun nas gzung ste/ dgag dbye byed pa po'i mdun du tsog pur 'dug la/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i yang dgag dbye bco lnga pa lags na bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bdag la mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ dogs pa'i gnas gsum gyis dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid kyi/ tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis bdag la gdams su gsol/ rnams kyis bdag la rjes su stsal du gsol/ rnams kyis bdag la rjes su gzung du gsol/ thugs brtse ba can tshe dang ldan pa rnams kyis thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag la thugs brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ ltung ba shes shing mthong na chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin slar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ thabs legs bya'o// de nas byed pa po des kyang gzhan gyi drung du dgag dbye bya'o// byed pa pos rtswa'i chun po rnams bsdus te/ gnas 'dir dbyar gnas pa'i dge slong 'di snyed kyis dgag dbye mdzad do zhes go bar byas pa'i rjes la/ gral la 'khod pa rnams kyis legs par dgag dbye mdzad do// shin tu dgag dbye mdzad do zhes go bar bya'o// de nas bskos pa des rdzas khab yan chad du longs pa thogs te btsun pa/ rdzas 'di lta bus kyang dbyar gnas pa'i dge 'dun la dgag dbye bgyid rung ngo zhes brjod cing 'gyed/

de'i 'og tu dge tshul rnams kyis dgag dbye bya'o// dge tshul zhes pa las gzhan snga ma bzhin no// dge 'dun ma longs na byin brlab bya'o// dbyar zla ba gsum gnas nas dgag dbye byed pa spyir btang*/ dmigs bsal gso sbyong gsum mam gnyis thal nas/ dus kyi dgag dbye'i nyin dge slong 'thab krol can mang po byung na 'then nas de nas zla ba phyed song ba'i gso sbyong gi dus der bya ba rnams so// de lta bu gso sbyong dang cho ga ma mthun pa tsam ma gtogs dgos pa gcig tu song bas 'di byas pas gso sbyong byas par song ngo*// tshogs kyi dgag dbye ni/ dge slong gang yang rung ba zhig gi mdun du dgongs gsol byas nas sngar bzhin du byed pa'o// 'dul ba'i gnas kyi rab dang 'dod pa la// legs bshad 'di ni mā la yar skyes bzhin// blo gros rgya mtsho'i pad dkar 'dzum pa'i las// 'jig rten gsum gyi phan bde'i gnyen du bskos// de yang gzhi gsum gyi lag len gyi cho ga phan bde'i gnyen zhes pa/ bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i dmag sde'i dbus/ thub bstan lang tsho bdo ba'i thang*/ byams pa chen po'i chos kyi gling du/ grwa sa de nyid kyi 'chad nyan pa ngag dbang 'jam dpal grags pas bskul ba ltar/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa pad+ma dkar pos lung bzhin du sbyar bas rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas shing dar bar gyur cig// /
